page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m2.large is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 2 shared vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It operates under the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because the vCPUs are shared rather than dedicated, compute performance may vary depending on host load, representing a tradeoff between consistent high-throughput processing and resource cost.

Given its shared CPU allocation and modest memory capacity, the ecs.s6-c1m2.large is structured for budget-conscious, low-intensity workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for non-production environments, lightweight web serving, microservices, development and testing environments, and basic utility tasks that do not require sustained, high-performance compute or dedicated hardware resources.
